comment: The Cluster knob is configured 1 to 8 while its jack is clamped to 1 to 10, Pulsar.cpp:108 and Pulsar.cpp:130, so the top of the jack's span is held at the knob's own limit. The duty sum is clamped to 1.99 although the knob stops at 0.99, Pulsar.cpp:148, so a cable can push the pulse past the length of one cycle. The three jacks that move knobs are read monophonic even though the module is polyphonic.
